title: CY40014: Introduction To Computational Chemistry
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Prerequisite: Nil
Introduction to programming languages; basic numerical analysis: solution of
nonlinear equations using Newton-Raphson method, solution of linear systems
using Gaussian elimination and pivoting, interpolation and polynomial
approximation, numerical solution of differential equations: ODE and PDE:
analysis of convergence, stability and consistency; numerical integration; code
development and use of commercially available software to perform simple
quantum chemical calculations.
Book: Computational Chemistry Using the PC, D.W. Rogers.
